title: Development and Validation of the Early Gastric Carcinoma Prediction Model in Post-Eradication Patients with Intestinal Metaplasia
summary: Boruta/SHAP feature selection and comparison of 21 ML methods generated a five-feature CatBoost early-gastric-cancer model from 214 patients; internal AUC .743, independent Fujian external AUC .905. Small retrospective cohorts; external signal warrants cautious interpretation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: Fuzong Clinical Medical College of Fujian Medical University; 900th Hospital of PLA Joint Logistic Support Force
